name: Cinder Gate

detectability.signature: Brilliant gamma-ray flashes on the 511 keV annihilation line, flaring without warning as stray dust meets the pocket's boundary.

proximity: Gamma dosimeters scream as annihilation radiation washes over approaching vessels
Sensor arrays white out in rolling waves of interference from boundary flashes
contact: Instant and total annihilation of any matter crossing the boundary, releasing the full rest-mass energy of everything that touches it
Vaporization of hull sections with a flash visible from planetary orbit
prolonged_exposure: No vessel survives sustained presence; even hovering outside the boundary delivers lethal radiation doses within minutes
Cumulative gamma exposure kills shielded crews within hours of any extended approach

phenomena: Antimatter annihilation flashes strobe silently across the pocket's surface as interstellar dust arrives
Exotic particle showers erupt outward in unpredictable jets following boundary instabilities
Gravitational readings betray a mass far smaller than the void's violent reputation suggests
hazards: Complete ship destruction upon any boundary contact
Molecular disintegration within the pocket interior
Radiation exposure exceeding safe limits across the entire approach corridor
opportunities: Antimatter harvesting potential, if a containment method for remote skimming can ever be engineered
Data valuable to scientific institutions studying baryon asymmetry from safe long-range observation
known_incidents: The colony ship Perpetua Dawn, carrying eleven thousand settlers, was annihilated in under a second when its course solution placed it two hundred kilometers inside the boundary
description: The Cinder Gate is a sphere of pure antimatter thirty-one thousand kilometers across, hanging in space like a wound in the universe's accounting. It is invisible between flashes, a perfect black absence ringed by the silent fireworks of its own feeding. When dust and gas drift into its boundary, the resulting annihilation flash outshines the system's star for a heartbeat.

The pocket is violently unstable, swelling and shrinking by thousands of kilometers on timescales ranging from hours to seconds. Its boundary cannot be mapped, only approached statistically, and every survey attempt has returned different figures. Anything that crosses that shifting line ceases to exist as matter, converting entirely to gamma radiation in the most efficient reaction physics permits.

Long-range astronomers identified the Gate four centuries ago, after the loss of the Perpetua Dawn explained itself in the telescope record as a single unbearable point of light. The disaster rewrote colonial navigation law, and the approach corridors remain legally mandated as sterile of automated traffic to this day. Theorists still debate how a pocket this large survived the galaxy's matter-dominated history at all.

The Gate continues its slow, chaotic expansion, currently gaining roughly a meter per year on average. Energy consortiums fund increasingly desperate research into remote skimming, drawn by the absurd fortune suspended in the void. Until someone solves containment at a distance, the Cinder Gate remains what it has always been: the most valuable and most forbidden object in charted space.
